name: Waterloo Hacker Fab
description: An open-source, low-cost semiconductor fabrication lab, building tools like lithography machines to make chip fabrication accessible.

cycles.notes: The site's FAQ has a 'How do I get involved or contribute?' entry, but its answer wasn't accessible during verification and no application link was found. Try their Discord (linked from the site) or email waterloohackerfab@gmail.com directly.
